integrity.independence_claim: none; independent scholarly validation not performed
integrity.proof_scope: symbolic proof for arbitrary admissible lengths and path count; separately handles a direct terminal edge

scientific_limitations: Applies to finite simple generalized theta graphs with at least three terminal paths and at most one path of length one.
Total orientation counts and the all-length-two complete-bipartite specialization are not claimed as novel.
The formula determines local vertex degrees, not the full orientation-flip graph isomorphism type or pairwise distances.
Potential unindexed equivalent prior formulations or inaccessible broad orientation literature remain residual originality risks.
title: Local flip degrees and simple graphical-zonotope vertices of generalized theta graphs
